story_type: surfer stranded on rocks in breaking surf, swimmer lowered onto the rock, hoisted together
hook: Stranded on a rock with the Pacific crashing in.
narration: The surfer was stuck on a rock off the Oregon coast, with waves exploding all around it.
He had lost his board near Agate Beach and swum to the rocks. Then a wave knocked him down and he hit his head.
Another surfer stayed with him out there until help came.
A Coast Guard Dolphin crew got there twenty-two minutes after the call and lowered its swimmer.
A hoist over rocks is harder than over open water. Every wave shoves the swimmer, and the cable can snag on stone.
[short pause] The swimmer clipped the surfer to his own harness, and they rode the cable up together.
outcome: The surfer was flown to a hospital in Newport and treated for a head wound and exhaustion.
title: Surfer stranded on rocks in the surf
description:
On Dec. 13, 2017, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Air Facility Newport hoisted an injured surfer who was stranded on rocks in the surf near Agate Beach in Newport, Oregon.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/573234/airfac-newport-rescues-injured-surfer-near-agate-beach
